_source: Aggregates approved in the B2B Bulk & Infrastructure expansion that the pricing framework workbook's 'Sample Priced Catalogue' sheet does not list (B2B_BULK_CATALOGUE.md, Oct 2026). Each is priced exactly like a workbook row: its category's Category Markup Bands (base cost, markup, density) — no product-specific price is invented. Read by scripts/import_pricing_framework.py and appended after the workbook's products.
